evals.prompt: Add a nullable Jalali publication date field with dayOnly mode, Asia/Tehran display, ISO persistence, and virtual Jalali timestamps.
evals.expected_output: A native date-backed factory integration with explicit timezone/null semantics and focused formatter/timestamp/Admin tests.
expectations: Persists ISO/null rather than a Jalali string.
Treats Asia/Tehran as display configuration only.
Tests day-only local noon and virtual timestamp behavior.
Treats schema migration requirements as consuming-app dependent.

evals.prompt: Fix monthOnly so selecting Jalali 1403-02-15 stores the first Jalali day at noon, including Nowruz boundary tests.
evals.expected_output: A Persian DateLib startOfMonth implementation with exact local-noon regression tests.
expectations: Uses Jalali-aware startOfMonth instead of native setDate(1).
Adds boundary coverage without changing ISO persistence.

evals.prompt: Review a date field that stores Jalali strings, trusts HTML min/max for time inputs, crashes on invalid ISO/timezone, and has inaccessible time controls.
evals.expected_output: A persistence, validation, robustness, and accessibility review with layered tests.
expectations: Requires code-level time validation and invalid-state handling.
Requires label association and accessible names.

evals.prompt: Diagnose why dayAndTime loses edited time when a new day is selected and why timeOnly shows 00:00 but saves current minutes.
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded diagnosis of current DayPicker replacement and current-Date empty baseline behavior.
expectations: Traces chooseDay replacing the prior selected Date.
Traces empty timeOnly edits starting from new Date().
Proposes deterministic component tests before changing the contract.

evals.prompt: Fix package-wide Import Map exports and protected overrides for every Payload field factory.
evals.expected_output: A handoff to payload-fields-core while retaining Jalali component path requirements if relevant.
expectations: Recognizes package-wide architecture as payload-fields-core work.
Composes with core only for the Jalali Admin subpaths.
Does not expand date behavior unnecessarily.
